posts.pinComment: Shadow workflows + agents: Comment OPS for the seven-question ops checklist (approvals + publish planes + STOP).
posts.text:
If your "real" workflow is happening in five unofficial chats and a browser tab nobody names in the security review, you don't have shadow IT.

You have shadow operations.

AI didn't invent this.

It just made the gap easier to widen - because the fastest path is always the unapproved one.

I'm not here to shame speed.

I'm here to name the cost: audits, incidents, and the day legal asks for a trail you can't produce.

Adult version: publish the allowed path, make it usable, and measure who still routes around it - then fix the friction, not the person.

If you're a founder or ops lead standing up agents and you need a real approval + publish plane (not a slide) - DM me the stack in one paragraph.

If you're hiring for growth / AI implementation where "ship" includes governance reality - I'm open to the right role. Calendar link in my About; or DM the JD.

#AI #Governance #Security #Operations #Agents

posts.pinComment: Prod truth + agents: Comment OPS for the checklist link.
posts.text:
"We'll test in staging" is a nice sentence.

It is not always a real object.

Sometimes staging is a story the org tells so it can sleep.

Agents change the math: more branches, more variants, more "small" releases that are only small in the deck.

I'm not anti-staging.

I'm anti pretending.

If production is the only place the ugly edge shows up, then production is your test - whether you admit it or not.

Own that.

Build monitors, rollbacks, and human gates that match the actual risk - not the imagined one.

Teams shipping customer-facing agents and tired of demos that die in prod - DM me. I care about the boring safety layer.

Hiring for platform / AI / growth engineering where prod honesty is part of the job - calendar in About, or send the role.

#Engineering #Reliability #AI #Product #Operations

posts.pinComment: Knowledge + agents: Comment OPS for the doc.
posts.text:
Documentation is not a file type.

It is a responsibility assignment.

If nobody owns it, it becomes folklore - and folklore is how you get ten contradictory "sources of truth" and a very confident model.

Retrieval doesn't fix ownership.

It amplifies whatever you already tolerate.

The fix is boring: owners, review cadence, expiry, and delete paths.

Not sexy.

Cheaper than apologizing to a customer.

If you're building agent workflows and your doc strategy is still "we'll clean it up" - DM me. I like turning folklore into something a new hire can run.

If you're hiring a builder who treats knowledge as infrastructure - About has my calendar; or DM a one-line scope.

#KnowledgeManagement #AI #Engineering #Operations #Documentation

posts.pinComment: Buyer / vendor reality: Comment OPS for the checklist.
posts.text:
If the pitch says "AI" twelve times and "evaluation harness" zero times, you're not buying intelligence.

You're buying a mood.

AI washing is just the newest paint job on the oldest game: vague promises, hand-wavy integration, and a demo that survives until the first angry Tuesday.

Buyers: ask impolite questions - data boundaries, failure modes, human override, export, and what happens when the model updates.

Builders: if you sell real workflows, welcome those questions.

They separate you from the brochure crowd.

Founders evaluating agent stacks for growth or ops - DM me if you want a second brain on what to demand in a POC.

If you're hiring someone who has read enough RFPs to smell washing - calendar in About.

#Procurement #AI #SaaS #Engineering #Leadership

posts.pinComment: Incidents + automation: Comment OPS for gates + STOP.
posts.text:
Automation that fires at 2 a.m. still needs an owner at 2 a.m.

If your answer is "the bot handles it," you haven't finished the design.

You've renamed panic.

On-call is not a personality.

It is a contract: what wakes a human, what can auto-remediate, what must never auto-remediate, and who gets blamed when the playbook is wrong.

Agents make incidents weirder.

So the ownership graph matters more.

If you're standing up agent + toolchains without a clear on-call story - DM me. I like drawings adults can run under stress.

If you're hiring for reliability-minded AI / platform / growth engineering - About has my calendar.

#SRE #AI #Operations #Engineering #Culture
